create.title: Create this device's key
create.body: Veeloe signs every command you send with a key that stays on this device.

lost.title: This device's key no longer works
lost.body: Its biometrics changed, so the key was locked for good. A new key needs Pairing with your Machine again.

unsupported.web: This browser has no passkey that can verify you, so Veeloe can't create a key here.
unsupported.app: Set up Face ID or a fingerprint on this device, or use Veeloe on the web.

failed: The key wasn't created. Try again.
